label: Stop
intent: Playback brakes to a dead stop. Light: the block draws back, then drives forward with two speed lines laid behind it; it stops dead on its place, the lines cut off, and its momentum tips it forward onto its front corner before it rocks back to rest. Strong: a longer draw-back and a faster drive, a harder forward tip and one rock back onto its heel before it settles.

trail-a.//: hidden at rest: speed lines behind the block while it drives, laid from the block outward

block.//: tips forward on its front corner (positive) and rocks back on its heel (negative)
